title: Care Management Program Table — RideLink Community Health Class Bonus Trips
content:
Members in an active Care Management episode receive bonus Non-Emergency Medical Transportation value-added trips for community health classes.

**Rule.** Community health class bonus trips follow care management: an active Maternal Care Management or Complex Case Management episode adds the intensive class bonus of 4 trips to the year's value-added allotment; any other active care management episode adds the standard class bonus of 2 trips; no active episode adds none.

The episode looked at is the member's active Care Management episode and its tier.

## Tier table

| Member's active Care Management episode | Class bonus trips |
|---|---|
| Maternal Care Management | 4 |
| Complex Case Management | 4 |
| Any other tier | 2 |
| No active episode | None |

*Hypothetical cases:* an active Complex Case Management episode gives 4 bonus trips; an episode in the same tier that has ended, with no other active episode, gives none.
